_comment: Squatch gear on the walls, on the furniture, and printed on the things in the kitchen. Drop images into assets/art/ and point a slot at one. Slots without a file get a procedurally drawn placeholder. See README.md in this folder for the slot list.

art.caption: Green paint, ogre ears, not a flicker. The biggest frame on his own wall, which is how he would want it.

art.caption: Robes, halo, a bottle of wine and a basket of eggs. High on the foyer's west wall, level with the crest, where the double height finally earns its keep.

art.title: The stairway roster
art.caption: All of them on the stairway to heaven, under a very large ape. End of the gallery, so the walk past the founders finishes looking up.

art.title: The birthday girl
art.caption: A goldendoodle in a party hat, framed on the desk, facing Lou's chair. It was her birthday. Everyone had been informed.

art.title: Florence

art._comment: THE CARTEL PALACE'S SIX A-TEAM PIECES. ALL SIX LANDED 2026-08-25 from the owner, as .webp rather than the .png README.md had guessed -- the file is named here, so the extension is whatever was actually delivered. Four MORE arrived the same night, portrait rather than landscape; they are the gallery rows below.
art.title: The A Team
art.caption: Photographed on this drive, by this fountain, the week before anyone regretted it.

art.title: We don't miss
art.caption: Five men and four rifles making a claim. The bullet holes are in the wall behind them.

art.title: A Team Assault
art.caption: Four men, two doors, one plan. The one on the floor is tripping over the plan.

art.title: El Jefe
art.caption: Commissioned by the subject, hung by the subject, paid for by somebody else.

art.title: A Team Champions
art.caption: Three kills, forty-seven losses, five trophies. The trophies are for the losses.

art.title: A Team Strat
art.caption: Operation Dumb Luck. Step one is shoot stuff. Step two is blame someone else.

art._comment: THE PORTRAIT GALLERY'S FOUR CANVASES. Delivered 2026-08-25, portrait 1122x1402 where the other six are 4:3 -- so they hang on the four wallArt frames in the gallery corridor, authored at 1.0 x 1.25 to match, rather than on the six frames authored for landscape. They are also the only A-Team pieces every player is guaranteed to see: the gallery is the one stretch of the route with no way around it.
art.title: Respect Us
art.caption: Commissioned, framed and hung by the only four people who agree with it.

art.title: A Team Master Plan
art.caption: Step one is a question mark. Step two is profit. Nobody has ever asked about step one.

art.title: Stealth Mission
art.caption: Graded F minus by the man who planned it, framed anyway by the men who ran it.

art.title: Best Team
art.caption: Fourth of four, twelve points, and a banner they paid for themselves.
